subject: NimbleHealth packaging prioritization and pilot pricing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: NimbleHealth packaging prioritization and pilot pricing

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a short proposal and the pricing model we used to build the recommendation. High level:

- Recommendation: run a 3-month throughput pilot (40M tokens/month) on our Compact+ bundle and then migrate to a reserved throughput tier if latency and QPS match your SLAs.
- Why Compact+ for pilot: lower per-token entry cost, includes monitoring and one dedicated onboarding engineer so we can validate tail latency quickly.
- Upgrade path: pilot -> 12mo commit on Throughput Tier w/ stepdown guardrails if usage drops (60/40/20% stepdowns over first 6 months).

Open items I flagged for procurement in the proposal: committed discount level, onboarding credit, and a clear downgrade step schedule. Can you confirm which of the following matters most so we can tailor?

1) Short-term cost predictability (higher commit, higher discount)
2) Flexibility to downscale after pilot (lower long‑term commit but more conservative discount)
3) Feature bundling (do you need the premium routing + audit logs add-on in pilot?)

Attached: NimbleHealth_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf and redwood-pricing-model-nh.xlsx (pricing scenarios).

If you like, I can loop in our pricing lead (Lauren) for a one‑pager that presents 2 concession paths.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: [NimbleHealth_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-pricing-model-nh.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Lina Park <lina.park@nimblehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbleHealth packaging prioritization and pilot pricing

Ben —

Thanks, this is helpful. A couple quick notes from procurement & product:

- Procurement will need a 15% target for committed spend to get approvals quickly. If we can get closer to 18% on a 12-month commit, that would make the legal/finance review smoother.
- Product is OK with Compact+ if it includes premium audit logs and per-route tracing for the pilot. They want the ability to flip to Throughput Tier mid‑pilot if we validate SLAs.
- Downgrade path: we need clarity on seat/throughput stepdowns and credits if we scale down after month 3. Procurement hates surprise charges.

Can you send a version that shows: (A) 3-month pilot cost and what upgrades look like month 4 onward, (B) a 12-month committed price with two discount options (15% and 18%) and the downgrade step schedule?

Thanks — Lina
Lina Park
Head of Product Operations | NimbleHealth

On Thu, Aug 19, 2027 at 3:04 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message attached)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: NimbleHealth packaging prioritization and pilot pricing — need pricing paths

Folks —

NimbleHealth is asking for a two-path pricing view: 3-month pilot numbers and 12-month commits at ~15% and ~18% levels. Also need explicit downgrade/stepdown rules and a one-time onboarding credit request. They want audit logs and per-route tracing included in pilot.

Can you:
- Lauren: prepare two clean rows (15% vs 18%) with monthly cost, per-token unit, and downgrade step schedule.
- Priyom: legal/finance constraints we should bake in (credit cap, max stepdown frequency, PO timing).

I drafted a short reply in case we want to keep momentum.

—Ben

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: NimbleHealth packaging prioritization and pilot pricing — need pricing paths

Ben —

Thanks. Proposed concession framing (keeps margin and limits churn risk):

Option A (Conservative): 12‑month commit, 15% discount, onboarding credit = $8,000, Downgrade schedule: allowed once after month 3 with 60% of committed throughput retained as minimum for remainder of term. No retroactive credits.

Option B (Aggressive close): 12‑month commit, 18% discount, onboarding credit = $15,000, Downgrade schedule: two-step plan (month 4 and month 7) with step sizes 40% then 20%. Requires commit notification 30 days in advance and a PO signed within 45 days.

Pilot (3 months): Compact+ bundle with audit logs & per-route tracing included free for pilot. If Nimble flips to Throughput Tier during pilot we will pro‑rate the commitment and apply the selected discount option.

Priyom — any legal redlines to call out? My ask: limit the onboarding credit to one-time use, and include language that protects Redwood on appetite for midterm downscales (minimum committed floor).

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Pricing Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Revised proposal: two commit paths + pilot detail (attached)

Hi Lina —

Per your ask, attached is a concise view of the two commit paths and pilot logistics. TL;DR:

- 3‑month Compact+ pilot (includes audit logs, per-route tracing, one onboarding engineer). Pilot cost: $18,500/month (40M tokens/month).
- Option A: 12‑month commit at 15% discount, onboarding credit $8,000, one allowed downgrade after month 3 (60% floor).
- Option B: 12‑month commit at 18% discount, onboarding credit $15,000, two-step downgrade allowed (40% at month 4, 20% at month 7) with 30‑day notice and PO within 45 days.

We also included a sample stepdown amortization table in the pricing workbook to show invoice impacts. DocuSign link for Option B: https://docusign.example/nh-optionb (expires in 14 days).

If you want, we can lock Option B for 7 days while you run this past procurement. Otherwise Option A is stable for 30 days.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: [NimbleHealth_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-pricing-model-nh.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Lina Park <lina.park@nimblehealth.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised proposal: two commit paths + pilot detail (attached)

Ben / Priyom —

We reviewed with procurement this morning. Good news: procurement is happy to proceed with Option B (18% + $15k onboarding credit) contingent on:

- Legal review of the stepdown language (Priyom, please confirm you can move quickly).
- Nimble will issue a PO within 30 days and target signing the DocuSign within 10 business days once legal confirms language.

We appreciate you including audit logs and tracing in the pilot. Please put me in touch with the onboarding engineer so we can schedule a kickoff.

Thanks — Lina
Lina Park
Head of Product Operations | NimbleHealth
